id.description: Task identifier (UUID), also the record key.

event_id.description:
Unique id of this event (UUID), also the event_id header — the
consumer's de-duplication key. Optional for compatibility with events
published before it existed.

version.description: The task's version after the change (1 for a new task). Optional, as event_id.

description: Published when a task is created (event_type task.created).
